newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Sonae down 2 pct after results.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Sonae down 2 pct after results.

text.p: Shares of Portuguese retail and real estate group Sonae Investimentos dropped two percent on the Lisbon bourse after its 1996 results fell short of some of the most optimistic expectations of investors, dealers said.
They said the weakness of European bourses was also weighing on the stock.
"Foreign investors are reducing their exposure to Sonae," said one dealer.
Sonae Investimentos yesterday announced a net profit after minority interests, excluding extraordinaries, of 8.6 billion escudos, up from 4.6 billion in 1995.
Sonae shares fell to a low of 5,151 escudos before recovering to stand at 5,300, down 100, in volume of 60,664 shares at 1250 GMT.
